svg.text: <!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>SVG and MathML Islands</title></head><body><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24" role="img" aria-label="Plus"><title>Plus</title><path d="M12 3v18"></path><path d="M3 12h18"></path></svg><math display="inline" alttext="x plus one"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math></body></html>
